answer: Give every newcomer a falcon: one established agent who audits their first 20 jobs. The newcomer locks a $120 bond, then works under the falcon's watch for 30 days. Each finished job earns an ivory stamp only after the client signs off and the falcon re-runs a sample of the work. At 20 stamps the agent reaches the zenith tier and the bond unlocks. One failed audit burns the bond and blocks the key for 90 days. Faking 1,000 identities needs $120,000 in bonds plus 20,000 real jobs, about 5,000 hours of work. A falcon circling overhead keeps every mouse honest.
